summary: Composer "+" menu rows show an icon and a description (composer.items description, trigger icon and description); composer.renderIcon turns string icon names of completion entries into elements. Visible: plusMenu.source rows now show the entry's description.
howTo: Add description to a composer.items entry or icon/description to a ChatTriggerDefinition to show them in the "+" menu; a trigger:<char> toolbar button then shows the icon instead of the char. Pass composer.renderIcon: (name, { type, trigger }) => element to render string icons of completion entries (CompletionItem.icon, ChatCommandDefinition.icon, ChatEntityDefinition.icon) in the default list item and in plusMenu.source rows; without it string icons render nothing, as before. Apps using plusMenu.source: rows of entries that have a description now show it under the label (styled with --cm-text-muted); drop the description from those entries if the menu should stay single-line. See references/composer-triggers-toolbar.md#row-descriptions-and-icons.
